messages:
Alex R: Quick proposal — instead of one long 4pm triage, split into two short syncs (morning + evening) to improve APAC coverage and catch regressions earlier. Proposal below.

Maria V: Sounds reasonable. What durations/attendance are you imagining?

Alex R: Morning quick-check 20m (8:30–8:50 PT) — overnight incident review + handoff. Evening wrap 20m (17:30–17:50 PT) — queue/throughput health + prep for overnight. Attendees: oncall, eng lead, one SRE, rotating PM.

Jamal K: Can one of these be primarily async w/ a short recording + notes? PMs and some EMEA folks can't always make both live.

Sophia L: I like the split. Async option + a concise notes template would help. Also we should explicitly name an escalation owner per incident in the agenda.

Alex R: Draft agenda (TL;DR):
```
1) Quick status (oncall) — 2 min
2) Open incidents (1-3 lines each) — assign escalation owner
3) Active rollouts / performance regressions — anything that changes SLAs
4) Blockers for handoff (configs, capacity)
5) Action items + owners
```

Maria V: @oncall-bot can you create the recurring invites once we lock cadence? Also can you attach the rota CSV to the invite?

oncall-bot: I can create recurring events and post a link to the rota. Please confirm cadence and timezone anchor (PT/UTC).

Jamal K: Rota CSV (draft): /docs/oncall/rota.csv. Suggest weekly rotation for escalation attendance across infra/platform/serving. Keeps knowledge shared.

Sophia L: +1 to weekly rotation. For RFC/design-heavy days we should be able to mark an "opt-out" on the calendar (skip) so reviewers aren't overloaded.

Alex R: Decision request: If you support (1) split cadence, (2) async option for one check, and (3) weekly escalation rotation, react with :thumbsup:. Will update playbook and create invites if majority thumbs up.

Maria V: :thumbsup:

Jamal K: :thumbsup:

Sophia L: :thumbsup:

Alex R: Great — I'll update the oncall playbook with the agenda and rotation, add the two recurring events, and post the rota link. Expect invites + a short playbook diff by EOD PT. Ping me if you want a different time.

oncall-bot: Created provisional calendar events (Morning quick-check, Evening wrap) and attached rota draft: /calendar/events/1779993333. If you need different slots, reply here and I'll reschedule.
